notes.title: Spear Master Receives a Major Update!
notes.content:
Get your controllers ready! Because now, you can dive into the action with 1 to 4 players (couch co-op), adding a whole new dimension to the gameplay experience!

Other noteworthy changes:
[list]
[*] New character designs have been added. So each player has a distinctive appearance
[*] Added enhanced compatibility for the Steam Deck
[*] Expanded language support to include Spanish, Italian, German, and French
[*] Due to the nature of multiplayer, the puzzle sections are now optional
[/list]

notes.title: Spear Master Update 1.6
notes.content:
Spear Master has been updated to version 1.6.0.

[b]Change list[/b]
- Added music to levels.
- Fixed money exploit bug in boss battles.
- Added achievement button to the pause menu when playing with a joypad
- Added conflict check in controller settings when assigning buttons.
- Added controller rumble to more sections of the game.
- You can now change outfits with a controller.
- Fixed a bug where switching controllers would show 'No Controllers Available' in the settings menu.
- Added confirmation message when clearing saved data.
- Localization changes
